visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of golden-brown potato chunks being stirred in a white ceramic frying pan with a light-colored wooden handle. A person's hand, partially visible with light blue nail polish, uses a grey silicone spatula to toss the potatoes. The background is a clean, white-tiled kitchen with bright, even lighting. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of a woman with short brown hair wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and a dark grey apron. She is standing behind a kitchen counter, holding the frying pan's handle. The kitchen in the background is modern and well-lit, featuring light wood cabinets and a stainless steel sink. (3) A close-up shows the pan again as a metal spoon sprinkles a brownish seasoning from a glass jar onto the sizzling potatoes. The person's hand is visible, holding the jar steady. The lighting remains bright and clinical, emphasizing the texture of the food. (4) The camera focuses on the woman's hands as she expertly folds a square of brown parchment paper and presses it into a white porcelain bowl on a white countertop. She wears a silver bracelet on her left wrist. (5) The potatoes are poured from the white pan into the parchment-lined bowl. The action is captured in a close-up, showing the steam rising and the oil glistening on the cooked potatoes. (6) A small green-labeled spice bottle is shaken over the bowl of potatoes, depositing green parsley flakes. The movement is rapid, and the close-up framing highlights the contrast between the green herbs and the yellow-brown potatoes. (7) A hand lifts a tan lid from a grey pot, revealing a vibrant red soup with large pieces of green leafy vegetables and a poached egg. Steam rises from the hot liquid, and the shot is a direct top-down view. (8) Looking through the glass window of a white air fryer, several breaded patties are seen browning on a metal rack. Light reflects off the glass, and the interior light of the appliance illuminates the food. (9) The woman, wearing a white heat-resistant glove on her right hand, uses black chopsticks to transfer the golden-fried patties from the air fryer tray to a white oval plate. The background shows more of the kitchen environment. (10) A close-up shows a white seasoning shaker being used to sprinkle fine white powder over the fried patties on the plate. The hand moves in a steady, back-and-forth motion. (11) The final shot is a medium full shot of the dining table. The woman walks into the frame from the background carrying a plate, then sets it down. The table is laid out with several dishes: the potatoes, the shrimp patties, the soup, a plate of cabbage, and a bowl of cherry tomatoes. A pink floral emoji and the text '今日晚餐' are overlaid.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with upbeat, medium-tempo acoustic pop music featuring a bright piano melody and rhythmic guitar strumming. Over the music, a clear and continuous sizzling sound of food frying in a pan is heard, indicating a high-heat cooking process. (2) A sharp, percussive metallic thud occurs as the frying pan is placed onto a hard surface, followed by the faint scraping of a spatula. The background music maintains its consistent energy and tempo without interruption or change in volume. (3) A metallic scraping and tapping sound is heard as a spoon is used to remove seasoning from a glass jar. The sound is dry and distinct, contrasting with the lush piano chords of the background music that continues to play. (4) A loud, multi-layered crinkling and rustling sound of paper being manipulated is heard as parchment is placed into a bowl. This incidental noise is prominent in the mix, momentarily competing with the clarity of the musical track. (5) A series of wet, soft thudding sounds occur as cooked potatoes are poured into the bowl. The sound of the pan scraping against the bowl's edge adds a subtle ceramic texture to the acoustic environment. (6) A rapid succession of plastic clicking sounds is heard as a spice jar is shaken vigorously. Each click is sharp and brief, synchronized with the visual action of seasoning, while the music provides a steady harmonic floor. (7) A distinct hollow suction and lifting sound is heard as a pot lid is removed, followed by the muffled bubbling sound of boiling liquid. The acoustic space feels slightly more open as the steam and sound escape the pot. (8) The continuous, low-frequency mechanical hum of an air fryer's fan becomes a subtle layer in the background noise floor. This steady drone is punctuated by the rhythmic strumming of the acoustic guitar in the BGM. (9) Sharp, high-frequency clicking sounds of wooden chopsticks hitting a metal tray are heard repeatedly. These transients are crisp and well-defined, standing out clearly over the balanced mix of music and appliance hum. (10) A mechanical sliding and clicking sound occurs as a kitchen drawer is opened and closed. This is followed by a fine, granular clicking sound of a seasoning shaker being used, creating a delicate percussive texture. (11) Multiple ceramic clinking sounds are heard as plates and bowls are placed onto a wooden dining table. The sound reflects a change in the environment, transitioning from active cooking to the final presentation of the meal.
